create_encoder_vanilla: create a vanilla transformer encoder with rotary positional embeddings and multi-head attention
create_encoder_mamba: create a mamba-based encoder using stacked Mamba2 blocks with layer normalization
create_encoder_performer: create a performer encoder using FAVOR+ attention with configurable kernel transformations
create_encoder_t5gemma: create a T5Gemma encoder wrapper around Hugging Face with optional weight freezing
build_encoder_factory: build an encoder factory using EncoderType enum to instantiate vanilla, mamba, performer, or t5gemma encoders
